title: 国会刚通过临时拨款：为何空头仍押注9月停摆？，内部人士透露真实原因
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Great to see you, Mark. I hope your summer's going well. I can't imagine what lawmakers are going through as they come back to town here knowing that they're handcuffed.
segments.zh: 马克，很高兴见到你。希望你夏天过得不错。我无法想象议员们回到国会时的心情，他们知道自己束手无策。

segments.en: How do you get the floor back open? I think that they're going to have a challenge getting the floor back open.
segments.zh: 如何重新开放议事厅？我认为他们面临挑战。

segments.en: I think they're making the right case by going to the present. He probably has as much leverage ever.
segments.zh: 我认为他们通过诉诸现状做出了正确的选择。他可能拥有前所未有的影响力。

segments.en: Luna has anybody else, but I still think that you have such incredibly narrow margins right now and any legislation they're passing.
segments.zh: 卢娜和其他人一样，但我认为目前多数优势极其微弱，任何立法都难以通过。

segments.en: I think it's getting more and more difficult to get closer in November because your margin in the Senate is pretty tight, too.
segments.zh: 我认为11月前通过法案越来越难，因为参议院的优势也很紧张。

segments.en: Yeah, sure is. Well, certainly so. And we'll get to that margin in the Senate in a moment, Mark, when we consider, though, that the president does seem to have a fixation on the very same thing.
segments.zh: 确实如此。我们稍后会讨论参议院的优势，马克，但总统似乎也执着于同一件事。

segments.en: Anna Paulina Luna does, which is the Save America Act, despite repeatedly being told by leadership that the votes are not there as it stands.
segments.zh: 安娜·保利娜·卢娜也是如此，她推动《拯救美国法案》，尽管领导层一再表示目前没有足够票数。

segments.en: He's not abandoning the effort. Is he going to be forced to, at some point?
segments.zh: 他没有放弃努力。他最终会被迫放弃吗？

segments.en: Well, I think that some of us are more cynical, think that the president knowing what the prospects look like in the midterms can say, look, I told you guys what happened if you
segments.zh: 嗯，有些人更愤世嫉俗，认为总统知道中期选举的前景，可以说：看，我告诉过你们如果不通过《拯救法案》会怎样。

segments.en: didn't pass the Save Act. And so there's a little bit of, I think, setting up for what is likely to be a political downer coming November for those of us who are Republicans.
segments.zh: 所以我认为，对于共和党人来说，这多少是在为11月可能出现的政治低谷做准备。

segments.en: But I think that there's the House strategy is to break the Save America Act and basically move it as part of our reconciliation 3.0 and to tie funding to states to actually implement
segments.zh: 但众议院的策略是拆分《拯救美国法案》，将其纳入和解3.0，并将资金与各州实施该法案挂钩。

segments.en: the Save Act at a state-by-state basis.
segments.zh: 逐州推进《拯救法案》的执行。
